gull.notes: Single gulls (OpenGameArt) and one NPS western-gull flock clip.

creak.notes: Wooden groans/creaks for the hull; play slowed (playbackRate 0.6-0.9) for a heavier ship.

canvas.notes: Cloth snaps/rustles for setting or furling sail.

rope.notes: Short wooden creaks standing in for rope through a block.

harbour_bell.notes: Distant church bell tolling (with birdsong); loopable bed with faded ends.

harbour_crowd.notes: Outdoor wharf with voices, faded ends; play low and low-passed for distance. (An indoor restaurant bed was dropped: it may carry background music the recordist could not license.)

thunder.notes: One sharp clap and one long rolling peal.
